config.name: Exe Estuary

calibration.method: coordinate search, high water and timing at Lympstone

config._note: Bed levels are ASSUMPTIONS (mAOD), to be calibrated against Lympstone. Thorverton-to-Exeter lag (120 min) is assumed. The Exeter Ship Canal is not modelled. Lympstone dries at low tide (its low-water readings show the sensor level), so it is used for high water only.
